action.text: Task: Add port access regression tests (text + bytes) for urlsplit/urlparse and doc examples. Implementation: port property checks port not None, then port.isdigit() and port.isascii(), then int(port), then 0<=port<=65535. Two ValueErrors: 'Port could not be cast to integer value as {port!r}' and 'Port out of range 0-65535'. Construction always succeeds; .port access raises. Insertion point: between test_urlsplit_attributes (ends ~line 618) and test_urlsplit_remove_unsafe_bytes. File sha: c8f4d478470cb5b3e9daa653a42d029be19aef842fd9577fd524415ce2f037d1. Candidate: 2921cbc8a115c86871a11f8eaea929c3d48a8e4d2bb2ca03bf48971c36cf15cd. Plan: patch test file inserting two new methods, then patch doc file.
